coverage.accepted_boundary: Complete already-admitted corrected principal L092 contract, with stated external classifications and explicit exclusions. Not every printed auxiliary assertion or historical geometric name.

findings.finding: Both multiplicative stars were lost in the converted expression for the cyclic quotient of order five.
findings.resolution: Exact replacement by F16*/F4* in separate frozen notation overlay. One TeX replacement; only the LinearBases bytes/hash update in scope; all 79 topic rows and 34 locator IDs unchanged. Only extracted PDF p4 changes, independently viewed.

mathematical_assessment.common_induction: Flag extension, reconstructed design automorphisms, the sequential chamber fiber, derived residues, complete residual-connectivity induction and rank-two intersection cases support the applications with their stated finite/firm hypotheses.
mathematical_assessment.rank_three: The classification necessity uses partial linearity and connected residues without the false unrestricted Delta converse. Projective and affine base cases, the exceptional AΓL(1,16) action, point iteration and higher-dimensional obstructions are complete.
mathematical_assessment.deleted_line: The full group includes coordinate exchange. Residual connectivity is q>4 while chamber transitivity is q=4 or 8, so q=8 is the corrected A-geometry value. These are separately proved all-parameter assertions.
mathematical_assessment.hermitian: The actual shell-to-projective-incidence map, complete residue argument and regular PGU action are retained. The diameter/girth proofs and every Figure 2 numerical discrepancy have explicit written justifications.
mathematical_assessment.higher_rank: Retained Kantor classification plus binary and subline reductions, actual small-Witt full-group bounds, exact large-Witt derivative/fiber interfaces and common theorems give the corrected final list.
mathematical_assessment.witt: All Figure 3 sizes, panels and actual group structures are tied to explicit actions, kernels and complements in the separately accepted finite interface. Type multisets prove the two rank-five residues nonisomorphic; no Pasini-name identification is inferred.
mathematical_assessment.counterexamples: The cyclic biplane and conventional four-edge-path counterexample are complete in the written application. These are earlier accepted corrections, not new conjecture resolutions.

independence_and_reuse.reviewer_prior_contributions: The reviewer contributed inherited Hermitian transport and path-length work and earlier reviews. These roles are disclosed rather than called independent new proof verification.

current_program_formal_review.scope: Reused separate current program/formal review; no second GAP or Lean execution in this review.

independence_and_reuse.not_claimed: This written/source review does not independently re-adjudicate the reviewer’s own inherited transport proof, nor claim that all current geometry is Lean verified.

verification.check_scope: Exact evidence, one literal notation delta, unchanged row dispositions, 21 proof-span hashes and PDF page-text delta. These controls are evidence checks, not mathematical proof tests.

retained_limits: BDL/Kantor classification theorems and classical actions are outside inputs.
The finite full-automorphism computation uses the accepted GAP DESIGN/GRAPE algorithms; the independent witness validator does not prove search completeness.
The Hermitian question is an existing accepted result and is not counted again.
Pasini Γ23(4)/Γ8(4) object maps remain unproved; broad abstract claims beyond partial linearity are excluded.
No new source, principal, conjecture or formal declaration credit; no ratio.
publication_authority: Root decides admission; this is the bounded Steiner review only.
